description: Where the treasury template's code and patterns come from. No audited open-source program covers a pool vault with a FIFO withdrawal queue, allow-listed deposits and timelocked terms, so the template adapts the proven parts below, each at a fixed commit and under its own licence (LICENSES/). Code copied or adapted is marked at the top of the file it went into; a pattern is a design followed without copying code.

sources.name: Jito Restaking: vault program
patterns: the vault's token account is owned by the vault's PDA and moves only by the program signing with its seeds
two-step exits: a withdrawal is enqueued as its own account and paid only after a cooldown (here, the notice period)
a deposit capacity (here, the commitment maximum per depositor)
split roles: the admin and narrower secondary admins (here, the authority and the health authority)
the vault's own mint can never be delegated away (here, there is no approve, set_authority or close instruction at all)
not_adopted: Jito's set_is_paused pauses withdrawals too; here no authority can pause exits

sources.name: OnRe: onre-sol
patterns: allow-listing by an approver's Ed25519 attestation with an expiry, verified from the precompile instruction just before (adapted code)
redemption requests as their own PDAs, filled in part or in full
a kill switch that only stops new business (here, the sponsor and health pauses stop deposits only)
not_adopted: two-step ownership transfer (propose_boss/accept_boss): the authority is a Squads vault whose members change inside Squads; see README open questions

sources.name: Squads v4
patterns: every pool authority is a Squads vault PDA with a time lock; the treasury only checks the authority's signature and never includes Squads code

sources.name: Token ACL (sRFC-37)
patterns: KYC'd share tokens on Token-2022 default-frozen accounts thawed by an allow-list: the documented alternative to v1's attestations (README)

sources.name: Circle CCTP V2 for Solana
patterns: cross-chain USDC lands in the depositor's own token account first, then enters the vault through deposit and its allow-list (README)
